a.speaker: Inez Varga
a.text: Inez has her handheld radio on the porch rail and a notebook full of call signs. "The hams hear things before the news does. Want to listen in for an hour?"

how.speaker: Inez Varga
how.text:
"Half of it is noise. The trick is which stories hold up when you check them."

[How it works] The Signal Board lists the news about seven possible disasters. Each look tells you if a story holds up. Stories that hold up raise the odds for that disaster. You get 3 extra looks tonight.
